description: Evidence-driven AI/software forensics and supervised engineering with one unified PRE Core for progressive roadmap governance, exposed in A.S.F.R.E.E through the RPEDS compatibility adapter.

defaultPrompt: Forensically audit this system and design evidence-backed improvements.
interface.longDescription: A.S.F.R.E.E coordinates authorized AI/software forensics and supervised engineering through M00 and canonical specialists O01–O12. One shared PRE Core supplies the roadmap lifecycle; RPEDS is its A.S.F.R.E.E compatibility adapter under M00, not a separate roadmap engine or O13. AFSA maps PRE Core to local SOP, authority, security and data boundaries. O11 retains security/authorization; O12 retains evaluation judgment; O10 retains verification. This 0.5.0-rc.2 source candidate includes the adapter contract and skill; event-driven cross-host adoption still requires configured source registry, event transport, credentials, CI, persistent receipts and end-to-end verification.
